# Klinik Sehat Booking

## Vision
Patients of a small dental clinic book, reschedule, and pay without phoning the front desk.

## Target Users
Patients, receptionists, and the cashier at a single-location clinic.

## Core Value Prop
Fewer no-shows and less phone time for the front desk.

## Key Features
- [ ] Booking over WhatsApp
- [ ] Occupancy view for the receptionist
- [ ] Refunds at the cashier

## Non-goals
- Multi-branch scheduling

## Constraints
- Must work on the receptionist's existing Android tablet
